ctx.x: Oh, I know he played with Joe Jones' band, Wilbert Hogan.

Yeah, Wilbert Hogan. Yeah, well they had a bunch of musicians came out this city man, I can't remember all of them. And from time to time I'd meet one here and meet one and you know run into all kinds. I remember one time the union had some kind of squabble or something going on, Joe Jones and whatever it was going on. I played with Curtis Trevino, he played guitar. That boy played, he left here and went to California and did good for himself playing drums.
